title: Iran Tells US There Is No Military Solution to Middle East War
detail: Iran signaled continued opposition to military escalation by telling the United States there is no military solution to the ongoing Middle East war, reinforcing Tehran's diplomatic stance amid ongoing tensions.

title: Iran Vows Stronger Military Response to Any Future Attack
detail: Iran issued a warning signaling an escalation posture, vowing a stronger military response to any future attack. The statement underscores Tehran's deterrence strategy as tensions remain elevated following recent strikes and diplomatic maneuvering in the conflict.

title: Ghalibaf: Hormuz Stays Closed Until US Accepts Iran's Seven Conditions
detail: Iran's parliament speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the seven conditions based on the Islamabad memorandum are met, saying 'the era of wasting time and dictating unilateral demands is over.' Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran is serious about diplomacy but would defend itself if military action resumes. Trump ruled out Iran's reopening proposal last week.

media.caption: Iran says Strait of Hormuz to remain closed until US meets conditions

title: Iran's Oil Minister Paknejad Resigns Amid US Blockade
detail: Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned under pressure from the US blockade of Iranian oil exports; NIOC CEO Hamid Bovard was named acting minister by presidential decree. The rial hit new lows and the central bank injected up to $2 billion to support it.

media.caption: Iran talking peace, but unwilling to bend to Trump, US nuclear demands
